picks.name: Wallabee Shoe, Maple Suede
picks.why: Black Friday-list watch-list BUY, still £79.20 (was £99) with UK 10 in stock. It's the only smart-casual shoe option besides the Docs, so it covers office and date night with the fawn chinos and a navy knit, or the 502s at weekends. Wallabees run large: true size for normal feet; spray the suede before rain.

picks.name: 3001 Overshirt, brown
picks.why: No overshirts owned yet, and everyday, travel and date-night looks all want one. Same 3001 cut as the army green on the watch list, in a warm brown organic cotton at half price (£42.50, was £85), plain with a small woven label. Wear it open over a tee with the 502s and Sambas, or under the waxed jacket.

picks.name: Fisherman Raglan Jumper, Heavy Cotton, Navy
picks.why: Knits are still the biggest gap with none owned, and office, date and outdoor outfits all lean on one. A heavy 100% cotton rib crew, regular fit with raglan sleeves rather than a dropped shoulder, no branding, 40% off (£90, was £150). Wear it over a tee with the fawn chinos and Wallabees, or with the 502s under the field jacket.
